title: Mbodi AI (YC P25) Is Hiring Founding Machine Learning Engineer (Robotics)
summary: Mbodi AI, a Y Combinator Winter 2025-backed startup, is recruiting a founding machine learning engineer to build robotics AI systems. This early-stage hire offers equity and the opportunity to shape the technical direction of a new robotics company.
problem_solved: Hiring ML talent to develop AI-powered robotics capabilities for an early-stage startup.
why_valuable: Provides founding engineer status at a YC-backed company with equity potential and direct influence on technical architecture.
